title: Numbers, Days and Colours Foundations
welcome_lead: Build your starter Spanish vocabulary with numbers 1-20, the days of the week and core colours.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish foundations adventure covering numbers, days, months and colours.
final_note: ¡Bien hecho! You now have a solid vocabulary base to build.

concepts.def: Numbers 1, 2, 3 — the first three counting numbers.
Monday — first day of the Spanish week.
January — first month of the year.

walkthroughs.body_html: Spanish numbers 1-10: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho, nueve, diez. From 11-15 each has its own word: once, doce, trece, catorce, quince. From 16-19 we use dieci-: dieciséis, diecisiete, dieciocho, diecinueve. Then veinte is 20.
The days are: lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves, viernes, sábado, domingo. Note they are not capitalised in Spanish. To say 'on Monday' use el lunes; for 'on Mondays' use los lunes.
Core colours: rojo (red), azul (blue), amarillo (yellow), verde (green), blanco (white), negro (black). Colours agree with the noun: una casa roja, un coche rojo.
